name: King Shaka International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 06/24, 3,700 m x 60 m, asphalt

hours.v: aerodrome operator, ATS and handling H24
hours.quote: AD Operator: H24 ... ATS: H24 ... Handling: H24

fuel.v: Jet A-1 and Avgas 100; fuel operator Sky Tanking
fuel.quote: Fuel grades: JET A1; AVGAS 100; AVTUR

noise.v: noise and track monitored; Noise Abatement Departure Procedure 1; no engine tests or run-ups and no intersection take-offs 2000-0400 (AIP time, UTC = 22:00-06:00 local); minimise reverse thrust
noise.quote: No engine tests and run-ups between 2000 to 0400.

notes: Read: (1) SACAA AIP amendment page set FA AD 2 FALE, footer 'AMDT 1/26', '15 JAN 26' (https://caasanwebsitestorage.blob.core.windows.net/aip-ammendments/FA_AD_2_FALE_EN.pdf) - contains only AD 2.20-2.24 type pages (local regulations, noise abatement), not AD 2.3/2.12; (2) ATNS eAIP South Africa AD 2 FALE, 'valid from 15 JAN 2022' (cad.atns.co.za) for runway, hours, fuel, de-icing. Runway/hours/customs are therefore from the 2022 edition; no newer full AD 2 FALE page could be found, so status partial. AD 2.3 also says after-hours slots via O R Tambo AIS ('For slot after hours, operators to contact O R Tambo International AIS Unit') - this is an AIS briefing note, not an airport slot rule. AD 2.20 (2026): 'Intersection takeoffs will not be permitted between 2000 and 0400.' Times 2000-0400 assumed UTC per AIP convention (local = UTC+2); not stated on the page. No curfew stated. IATA code not stated in sources read. ACSA website not read.
